definitions: To treat someone badly because one is angry or upset about something else, rather than because of anything that person has done.
To direct one's anger or frustration towards an innocent person or object.
examples: Don't take your bad mood out on me!
He always takes it out on his family when he has a tough day at work.
She took her frustration out on the punching bag.
pastTenses: took out on, taken out on
